title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost

translated_title: TokenEconomizer：面向编程代理的经验驱动黑盒成本控制
translated_abstract: 前沿编程代理的进展大幅增加了AI辅助软件工程的token成本。它们的token效率通常是在孤立任务上进行评估的，而现实中的开发者则使用它们来持续构建、更新和维护大规模项目。这种不匹配促使我们在一系列现实编程任务序列上评估代理，我们发现代理会表现出反复出现的、依赖环境的token成本，而现有方法难以降低这些成本。为了最小化这些成本，我们引入了TokenEconomizer，这是一个外部控制器，能够在任务序列中削减特定环境的token成本。这些削减来自于三方面的决策：(i) 注入哪些操作性微技能，(ii) 剪除哪些持续无关的工具，以及 (iii) 何时干预无成效的失败循环。在Claude Code、Codex和GitHub Copilot CLI与前沿模型配对使用的情况下，TokenEconomizer平均降低了token成本。
tldr: TokenEconomizer是一个经验驱动的外部黑盒控制器，通过注入操作微技能、剪除无关工具和干预失败循环，显著降低编程代理在连续现实任务序列中的环境相关token成本。
en_tdlr: TokenEconomizer is an experience-driven external black-box controller that cuts environment-specific token costs of coding agents over task sequences by injecting operational micro-skills, pruning persistently irrelevant tools, and intervening in unproductive failure loops.
